sam_customer: Hey team — our CI started getting 401s when calling Redwood API after we upgraded the in-house CLI. Works for local dev, fails in CI behind our corporate proxy. Error: {\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"401 Unauthorized\"}

sam_customer: Quick curl from CI runner (scrubbed key -> <REDACTED>):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Apikey <REDACTED>::ci/runner-12" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sam_customer: Notice we append a small suffix after the key to tag requests (we do this for tracing). Locally we send plain Apikey <KEY> and it works. In CI the header looks truncated in our upstream proxy logs.

maria_support: thanks — can you paste the exact Authorization header value (redacted) as seen by the CI process (before proxy) and the proxy's incoming header (after)? also which CLI version?

sam_customer: CLI v0.9.4. From the runner env (pre-proxy):
```
Authorization=Apikey QWxhZGRpbjpvcGVuIHNlc2FtZQ==::ci/runner-12
```
Proxy (nginx access log shows):
```
Authorization=Apikey QWxhZGRpbjpvcGVuIHNlc2FtZQ==::ci/ru
```

sam_customer: so it appears the header was chopped mid-suffix. If we remove the ::ci/... suffix it works.

jon_eng: suspicious — we've seen header folding/truncation with certain corp proxies when header length exceeds ~96 chars or when token contains double-colon. Can you check if the proxy is configured to limit header size or if it parses `:` as a delimiter?

sam_customer: raised with infra; they say default proxy has large header buffer but a security filter normalizes header values and strips characters after second colon for Apikey scheme.

maria_support: recommended quick repro: from a CI runner shell (bypass proxy) run both variants:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Apikey <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
curl -H "Authorization: Apikey <KEY>::ci/runner-12" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
```
We expect first returns 200, second returns 401 when routed through proxy. Also try URL-encoding the suffix `%3A%3A` to see if proxy modifies it.

sam_customer: tried url-encoding — proxy decodes then truncates. Removing suffix or switching to a custom header `X-Redwood-Source` fixed it.

jon_eng: for a long-term fix, avoid appending data to the Authorization header. Use a separate header (X-Redwood-Source: ci/runner-12) or include metadata in request body/trace id. We'll also add a KB note: "Do not append suffixes to ApiKeys — use separate headers."

maria_support: thanks — I'll escalate KB and flag this as "proxy-normalization -> 401" with support doc and repro steps. Closing once KB published. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy log: created support/kb/proxy-normalization-401-dont-append-apikey 6532109899
